name: Qatari Nationality by Emiri Discretion -- Service, Skills, or Academic Excellence (Law No. 38 of 2005, Article 6)

requirements.blocker_text: Emiri decision that the person has rendered great service to Qatar.
Emiri decision that the person possesses particular skills the country needs.

sources.title: American University in Cairo, Center for Migration and Refugee Studies -- verbatim English translation of Law No. 38 of 2005, Article 6: Emiri decision may grant nationality outside standard requirements for great service, needed particular skills, or excelling students; these grantees may retain their original nationality as an exception to the general dual-citizenship ban

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Qatar). STATUS: DRAFT -- same tier-2 sourcing caveat as the other Qatari citizenship files. This is a fully discretionary Emiri grant with no published objective criteria -- selection_method 'assessed' reflects genuine case-by-case discretion, not a hidden threshold this research failed to find. dual_citizenship_allowed is TRUE for THIS route specifically -- Article 6 grantees are the one stated exception to Qatar's general no-dual-citizenship rule (contrast with qa_citizenship_naturalisation.json, qa_citizenship_by_marriage.json, qa_citizenship_by_descent.json, and qa_citizenship_reacquisition.json, all FALSE). evidence_required's 'difficulty' is set to 'often_impossible' deliberately -- an ordinary applicant cannot manufacture an Emiri decree; this route is realistically reachable only by people already positioned to be noticed by the state.
